datasets.name: Landslide4sense dataset
datasets.verbatim: The work proposed in the paper employs the benchmark multi-region and heterogeneous Landslide4sense dataset [1, 2], primarily consisting of satellite images and proposed as a part of a challenge.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: DEM data, 12 multi-spectral band data (B1-B12) from the Sentinel-2 satellite and a slope layer taken from ALOS PALSAR data are among the 14 geo-spatial layers that constitute each image.

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR data
datasets.verbatim: DEM data, 12 multi-spectral band data (B1-B12) from the Sentinel-2 satellite and a slope layer taken from ALOS PALSAR data are among the 14 geo-spatial layers that constitute each image.

methods.name: MRF-LaD (Hybrid transformer-augmented multi-residual framework)
methods.summary: MRF-LaD is an encoder-decoder segmentation architecture that integrates multi-residual convolutional layers, Efficient Channel Attention (ECA-Net), a Parallel Cross-Stage Partial (P-CSP) network, and a single-stage transformer block in the bottleneck to extract multi-scale and multi-resolution features for landslide detection.
methods.verbatim: Hence, this paper presents a novel encoder-decoder architecture, MRF-LaD, employing multi-residual convolutional layers along the encoder, decoder and the bottleneck paths with skip connections for automated landslide detection in satellite images.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present, without shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the MRF-LaD architecture is not provided or referenced.
